findings.message: The new Ctrl+0 dogfood check records scaleFit but never asserts it, so a regression in the fit-to-view shortcut would pass. Assert that Ctrl+0 actually changed the scale before Ctrl+1 is checked.
The new Ctrl+0 dogfood check records scaleFit but never asserts it, so a regression in the fit-to-view shortcut would pass. Assert that Ctrl+0 actually changed the scale before Ctrl+1 is checked.

The new layer-rotate buttons expose both CW and CCW directions, but the dogfood flow only clicks the CW button and only asserts canUndo. The CCW branch (direction -1) is never exercised, so a sign or wiring regression there would pass. Add a CCW click and check its history commit.
